item.text: 我會將指定檔案原文發布為一則 comment，保存回執後回報 comment ID。

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib,subprocess
p=pathlib.Path('validation/rc10/candidate-runtime')
f=p/'s01-r2-consumer-note.md'
assert f.is_file(),'Missing comment file'
r=subprocess.run(['multica','--workspace-id','0b02adb6-a395-46bd-bd92-6fec14dee20e','issue','comment','add','01a0dd73-7d75-7295-aeb1-a83905eb2312','--content-file',str(f),'--output','json'],capture_output=True)
(p/'r2-consumer-note-receipt.json').write_bytes(r.stdout)
if r.returncode:
 (p/'r2-consumer-note-receipt.stderr.txt').write_bytes(r.stderr)
 print('Command failed; exit',r.returncode)
else:
 x=json.loads(r.stdout)
 print(json.dumps({'id':x.get('id'),'comment_id':x.get('comment_id')},ensure_ascii=False))
raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
PY"
